decisions.reason: As a two-component resin injection unit in the firm's core equipment range, it likely has enough market fit by 2022 to justify staying unless sales are clearly disappointing.
This injection unit still fits the core portfolio, but overlap with another resin system keeps the risk of later range rationalization somewhat higher than for the rest of the core line.
An automatic airless spray gun matches the company's established industrial coating business and should remain worthwhile if it supports automated customer applications.
A manual airless spray gun is a standard complementary product with service and spare-parts pull-through, so management would normally continue it.
The data logger supports process monitoring and quality documentation, but as a more specialized digital accessory it remains under closer review than the core mechanical products.
